title: Early Prediction of Cerebral Vasospasm After Aneurysmal Subarachnoid Hemorrhage Using a Machine Learning Model and Interactive Web Application.
summary: ML model predicts cerebral vasospasm after aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage using clinical variables. Results compares predictions with angiographically confirmed vasospasm in a defined cohort; retrospective clinical validation.
